definitions.rationale: This rule macro-expands the named chooseNumProgram proof term into the translated Module constructor tree.
definitions.text:
rule chooseNumProgram
    => Module(
         FuncDef("choose_num", Params("x", "y"),
           Return(
             IfExp(
               Compare(Name("x"), CmpOp(">", Name("y"))),
               UnaryOp("-", Int(1)),
               IfExp(
                 Compare(BinOp("%", Name("y"), Int(2)), CmpOp("==", Int(0))),
                 Name("y"),
                 IfExp(
                   Compare(Name("x"), CmpOp("==", Name("y"))),
                   UnaryOp("-", Int(1)),
                   BinOp("-", Name("y"), Int(1))))))))

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the noEvenInRange mathematical summary as a Boolean condition on the interval endpoints.
definitions.text:
rule noEvenInRange(X, Y)
    => X >Int Y
       orBool (X ==Int Y andBool X %Int 2 =/=Int 0)

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the chooseNumContract predicate by expanding it to the sentinel and greatest-even Boolean cases.
definitions.text:
rule chooseNumContract(X, Y, R)
    => (R ==Int -1 andBool noEvenInRange(X, Y))
       orBool
       (R =/=Int -1
        andBool X <=Int R
        andBool R <=Int Y
        andBool R %Int 2 ==Int 0
        andBool Y <Int R +Int 2)

operational_rules.rationale: This K-cell observation step consumes an executed integer result and runs the contract checker, making it part of the verification model's operational behavior.
operational_rules.text:
rule <k> VInt(R) ~> checkChooseNum(X, Y)
        => VBool(chooseNumContract(X, Y, R)) ... </k>
